per_requirement.extracted_requirement: For routine navigations and small queries, the user interface shall respond within five seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support up to 350 concurrent active users without application-level performance degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall support 350 concurrent users without any degradation of performance in the application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application shall be essentially always available, allowing only scheduled maintenance windows: Monday–Saturday 03:00–04:00 Eastern and Sunday 01:00–05:00 Eastern.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall be available 24x7x365 with the exception of the following scheduled maintenance windows. Monday â€“ Saturday 3:00am to 4:00am EST Sunday 1:00amd to 5:00am EST'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application shall implement retries and idempotency for external calls so failures do not create inconsistent state.

The application shall cache non-authoritative data for performance but must validate, refresh, and always fall back to the authoritative source (statement DB, cardmember store, merchant service) for authoritative decisions.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: For core transaction attributes (e.g., amounts, timestamps) the system shall always obtain authoritative values from the statement database; profile fields from the cardmember store; merchant identifiers and categories from the merchant service.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Adjustment and posting requests to the posting and billing system shall be idempotent, retried on transient failures, reconciled if a response is not received, and must be auditable and authorized.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The Disputes application shall interface with the Cardmember Posting and Billing System. This will allow the Disputes application to request adjustments to cardmember and merchant's accounts. All adjustment requests must be sent to the Cardmember Posting and Billing System.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application shall enforce access controls integrated with enterprise identity/access management, using role-based access control as the baseline and attribute checks where necessary, to gate initiation of dispute types and adjustment requests.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall record an audit trail for every action affecting case state or triggering external requests containing who performed it, when, the payload, and responses; the trail must be tamper-evident, retained per policy, and searchable for e-discovery while minimizing unnecessary PII exposure.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The application shall degrade gracefully when dependent backend systems are unavailable: it must surface blocked actions clearly, queue or retry requests where appropriate, avoid unreconcilable partial state, and provide clear diagnostics for technicians.
Monitoring and alerting shall be in place to detect failures and support rapid remediation by operations.

Internal-only fields shall be segregated so they are not exposed to merchants or cardmembers; the API and presentation layers shall enforce claims-based decisioning and mask sensitive fields (e.g., PAN) in UI logs.
The dispute application shall call the letters API with a template identifier and populated fields and shall not handle rendering or printing itself to keep concerns separated.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Letters application. This will allow the Disputes application to request letters as part of the dispute initiation and dispute follow up process. All letter requests must be sent to the Print Letter Utility application.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI shall follow corporate UI standards and reuse accessible components and patterns provided by central design to ensure a consistent and accessible experience.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall prevent unauthorized initiation of dispute flows and record who did what for audits (baseline RBAC with extensible attribute checks).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Operational diagnostics shall be provided when degradations occur so technicians can identify which backend is failing and which actions are impacted.
